issues.span: 是靠不由原因造成來分別的
issues.evidence: Academic: the noble ones are distinguished by the unconditioned; the phrase is awkward for ages 8-12.
issues.fix: 因為高尚的人，是因為「不由原因造成」的東西而有不同的。

issues.span: 不管是好人家的兒子還是好人家的女兒
issues.evidence: Redundant repetition of 'son or daughter' makes the sentence clumsy; the segment only says that person produces much merit.
issues.fix: 那位好人家的兒子或女兒，都會因為這樣得到一大堆福氣。

issues.span: 不論是兒子還是好人家的女兒，送的禮物都非常大。
issues.evidence: Academic/Tibetan contain no statement that the gift is very large; they only set up a comparison with the person who holds and explains a four-line verse.
issues.fix: （刪去這句，直接接：）如果有人從這教導的一課裡，哪怕只記住一首四句的短詩，……

issues.span: 不論是兒子還是好人家的女兒
我得到了進入聖流的成果這個修行成果
issues.evidence: Academic: 'I have obtained the fruit of stream-entry'; the doubled 成果 / 修行成果 is clumsy.
issues.fix: 進入聖流的人會這樣想：「我得到了進入聖流的成果」嗎？

issues.evidence: Academic: if the stream-enterer thinks 'I have attained the fruit', that itself is clinging to a self. Nothing says he clings to the fruit; the added clause shifts what is grasped.
issues.fix: 為什麼呢？世尊，如果進入聖流的人心想：『我得到了進入聖流的成果。』這本身就是抓著「我」不放了。

issues.span: 覺得自己得到了這個修行成果嗎
issues.evidence: Redundant restatement of the thought; academic has just 'would the once-returner think I have attained the fruit'.
issues.fix: 只回來一次的人會心想：『我得到了只回來一次的成果』嗎？

issues.span: 覺得有修行成果，這樣想……那就是他抓著不放，抓著「我」不放
issues.evidence: Academic: if he thinks 'I attained the fruit', that is clinging to self; the extra 'has the fruit' and the vague 'clings' clause are tangled.
issues.fix: 世尊，如果只回來一次的人這樣想：「我得到了只回來一次的成果。」那就是他抓著「我」不放，

issues.span: 會覺得自己有修行成果，而這樣想
issues.evidence: Redundant, tangled lead-in; academic simply asks whether he would think 'I attained the fruit'.
issues.fix: 不再回來的人會這樣想：「我得到了不再回來的成果」嗎？
